authority: Official Response to the External QA Review, Cognitive Memory Benchmark v0.5.1-qa1b, 14 August 2026, section 2
aligned_with: A Computational Theory of Cognitive Memory
rule: Internal condition identifiers remain unchanged for compatibility. All protocols, reports, figures and manuscripts use the canonical names below. The expressions 'open-loop memory', 'verified memory' and 'relational memory' may be retained only as implementation descriptions and must not be used as primary scientific labels.

B0_LLM_ALONE.implementation_description: public rules plus raw longitudinal and current evidence

M0_OPEN_LOOP_MEMORY.theoretical_role: Formation-time mapping before the realised consequence is resolved.
M0_OPEN_LOOP_MEMORY.implementation_description: open-loop memory: B0 plus a prospective assumption and expected consequence

B1_VERIFIED_MEMORY.theoretical_role: Preserved resolved mapping with consequence, provenance, scope, and reconstructible grounds.
B1_VERIFIED_MEMORY.implementation_description: verified relational memory: M0 plus the resolved consequence and grounds

prompt_safety_note: This file is reporting-side only. It is never embedded in a model call payload, and public/world_specification.json is left byte-identical to the v0.5.1 release so that dataset, oracle, split and prompt identity remain checksum-verifiable.
